Messages.Author: Brian David Buvinghausen
Messages.Body:
Does anyone know the size of the estimated print run of the black 
bordered Jyhad as compared to the beta version of Mtg?  Also if you have 
the time I would truly appreciate a list of Jyhad including levels of 
rarity.  Please E-mail me at bdb0001@jove.acs.unt.edu if you are so 
gracious.

						Thanks for your time,
						Brian

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
The total initial print run of Jyhad will be 180 million cards.  This
is more than the alpha, beta, and unlimited print runs of Magic put together.
